topic: Empty, Finite, Infinite and Universal Sets
title: Is Nothing a Set? Empty Sets Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
All the even prime numbers bigger than 2: four splits by two, six splits by two, every even number after 2 splits by two. So is this set nothing, or something? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 1, Sets) we meet four kinds of sets: empty, finite, infinite and universal.

You will watch a live membership test leave a set completely empty, compare the empty set with the set {0} side by side, count the natural numbers past a thousand, a million and a billion without ever reaching the end, and draw the universal set as the rectangle every other set lives in. There are two pause-and-think questions, a worked example that sorts four sets into empty, finite and infinite, the {0} exam trap, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:
